name: ch.sidelined/sidelined
title: sidelined.ch
description: Who's out in the Swiss National League (ice hockey): injured, ill and suspended players, sourced

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: The 14 National League clubs, each with its slug, how many players are out right now (out), healthy scratches (scratches), players with the farm team or on loan (loans), when its sources were last read (checked_at), and its next National League game (next_game: date, home or away, opponent). Start here to compare clubs or to find a slug.

tools.name: get_team_absences
tools.description: Who is out at one club right now, and its next National League game (next_game): each player with type, reason as the source published it, since when, the expected return, confidence and sources. By default only players counted as out; ask for categories to include healthy scratches or loans.

team.description: The club: its slug from list_teams (e.g. "zug", "rapperswil", "lugano") or its name ("EV Zug", "SCRJ Lakers").

categories.description: Which entries: "out" (default: injured, ill, suspended and other absences), "scratch" (fit, left out by the coach), "loan" (farm team or another club), or "all".

tools.name: search_absences
tools.description: Unavailable players across the league, filtered by club, type and confidence. For example all injured players (type "injury"), or everything only inferred from lineups (confidence "inferred").

team.description: The club: its slug from list_teams (e.g. "zug", "rapperswil", "lugano") or its name ("EV Zug", "SCRJ Lakers").

confidence.description: How it is known: "official" (the club), "league" (National League, SIHF lineup sheets), "media" (checked report), "inferred" (missing from lineups, reason unknown).

categories.description: Which entries: "out" (default: injured, ill, suspended and other absences), "scratch" (fit, left out by the coach), "loan" (farm team or another club), or "all".

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Players newly listed as out ("opened"), open entries with a new type, reason or suspension length, or off or back on the club's medical report while another source keeps them open ("updated", with changed, suspension and club_report), and players no longer listed ("closed", with closed_reason), newest first, from the last 14 days. Healthy scratches and loans are not included. Use next_cursor as cursor for older changes.

since.description: Only changes from this date or time on (ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-10-27").

team.description: The club: its slug from list_teams (e.g. "zug", "rapperswil", "lugano") or its name ("EV Zug", "SCRJ Lakers").
